mythology: Sati's upper teeth (Oordhva Danta) fell here; known as Dakshina Kashi and the western gateway (Paschima Dvara) to the holy Srisailam hills.
pilgrimage_significance: Fifth Shakti Peetha of the Ashtadasha Shakti Peethas; supreme confluence of Siddha traditions, Shaiva Tantra, and Badami Chalukyan art.
historical_notes: Inscriptions date the complex to Badami Chalukya emperors Vikramaditya I and Vinayaditya; long renowned as a center of Siddha alchemy (Rasasiddhi).
